_comment: What tools/package-batch.js puts in this batch's upload package (batches/2026-10-b/upload/). Batch 2026-10-a's seven website patches are on the live branch (commit 39036014), so this batch applies none. The data files go to the website's data/2026-10-b/, so data/photos.json (batch 2026-10-a's photo records) is not overwritten; the specs read data/2026-10-b/ and merge both photos.json files. Every photo the pages show is under /images/buyers/<page>/, so one images folder serves all five. The sitemap and llms.txt entries are made from the built pages; each page is listed after its own hub (listAfter).

text.commit: Batch 2026-10-b: five buyer pages, inbound links, sitemap and llms files
text.specsRow: The five page specs and the batch's shared kit `_kit.js`.
text.dataRow: This batch's data files and its `photos.json`. The specs read them from here. The site's `data/photos.json` (batch 2026-10-a) is not changed; the specs read both.
text.stitch: the header and footer are unchanged; this keeps every page in step
pageChecks: The links in the page open, including the links to the other pages in this batch.

changes: `/buyers/first-time-home-buyer-myrtle-beach/` and `/buyers/relocating/which-town/` (with its spec, `data/relocating/pages/which-town.js`): a link to the affordable places page.

`/buyers/55-plus-communities/` and `/buyers/golf-communities/`: a link to the gated communities page; the golf page's FAQ answer on gates now says only what verified sources show. In the golf page's comparison table, the gate cells for Prestwick and Wachesaw Plantation now read "Gatehouse at the entrance" and Wachesaw East "Gate at the entrance" (they said a live guard around the clock, 24-hour security and security; no verified source shows staffing).
`/submarkets/carolina-forest/`: a link to The Farm at Carolina Forest.
`sitemap.xml`: the five pages, with their photos (Google image sitemap). The four buyer pages are listed after the buyers hub, The Farm after Carolina Forest.
`llms.txt`: the five pages, with their descriptions.
`llms-full.txt`: regenerated by `node build.js llmsfull`, so it carries the five pages' text.
`tools/blog-brain/`: the current Blog-Brain page tools (`page-kit.js`, `compare.js` and the files they load). The batch 2026-10-a pages are not rebuilt.
